publishedArtifacts.description: Exact-byte publication copy of the executed capture script; the docs/research/mario64-issue46-external-capture.ps1 file is a separate unexecuted template.

waterEntry.entryObservation: One below-threshold observation at y=-185.50542, waterLevelS16=-81, strict y < -181.

waterSettle.observation: Settled y=-161 at waterLevelS16=-81, action 0x380022C0, floor type 21. The -80 offset is runtime-only evidence; the static clamp mechanism is unproved.

waterStroke.observation: One A press; current action 0x300024D0, previousAction 0x300024D2 at sampled transition into 0x300024D1, then 0x300022C2 and 0x380022C0. No current-action 0x300024D2 row and no proven D2 exit predicate.

lavaContact.sampleLimits: At contact, floor pointer 0x801A2420, area pointer 0x8033B90C, index byte 1. Burn numeric action appears in 274 observations over 5.932 seconds, with counter values 112725..112891 and 20 repeated final reads at 112891; this is not a simulation-frame or burn-duration claim. Area index 3 is observed after the castle transition.

exactRomStaticRanges.predicate: Reads the water-level value into MarioState+0x76; exact branch sets Mario input flag 0x0200 when Y < waterLevel-10. This is not the entry condition.
Resets player input/state bits before invoking the collision/water field query and floor-surface consumer.
Player update calls the surface dispatcher and the water action dispatcher.
Sets the water-entry vertical comparison value to waterLevel-100, clears selected movement state, and sets action 0x300022E2.
Strict comparison Y < (s16 waterLevel at MarioState+0x76 - 100); true branch calls 0x80253488.
The player update's 0x40 moving-action handler calls the water-entry/action gate at 0x80269830. This function is a movement dispatcher, not itself the water-surface clamp.
Dispatches the observed numeric water actions to their corresponding handlers.

Water-idle handler checks the corresponding Mario flags/input: A input bit 0x2 sets action 0x300024D0; otherwise applies a vertical adjustment through helper 0x802710C4. This function alone does not prove the observed -80 surface clamp.
For clear Mario flag 0x4 and input bit 0x2000, increments timer; timer==14 selects action 0x300024D2. A-latch during timer 2..5 can reset at timer 9. This does not establish the D2 exit predicate.
Water-action-end handler can select the numeric breaststroke action 0x300024D0 when input bit 0x2 is set; otherwise it checks water-surface state before returning to 0x380022C0.
Water-plunge handler evaluates timer, velocity, surface and state gates; numeric actions include 0x300022C2 and 0x300024D2. It is not the D2 handler, and no D2-to-D1 exit predicate is claimed.
Water movement handler gates on vertical speed and Y <= waterLevel-100; no -80 idle clamp is derived from this function.
Save-file flags setter: applies the supplied flags with the file-present bit and marks the save data modified; not a water routine.
Guarded save-file flags getter used to read the current save slot's flags; not a water routine.
Floor-type-1 dispatcher invokes the burn helper when action bits 0x800 and 0x2000 are clear.
Floor-type-1 helper additionally requires action bit 0x10000 clear and Y < floorY+10, then passes numeric action 0x010208B7 to the action setter under flag gates.

limits: All PC and ROM ranges are half-open. The USA rev0 PC mapping PC 0x80245000 + ROM offset is used only for ROM offsets 0x1000 through 0xE855F; do not extrapolate it outside that identified main-code span.

Every listed static range and SHA-256 was independently checked against the identified ROM; the local bounded decompilation used for these notes has SHA-256 335B102C976DBDC681274B61F49DDC65F3E1D94D530D766930BDAE95DDB8EB94.
Raw traces, input logs, screenshots, ROM, game assets, save states and EEPROM remain local; only selected scalar observations and hashes are listed.
